title: Expression Puppet
pitch: Direct an expressive character with a few meaningful controls and complete short pose-matching challenges.
rules: Free-play lets user control look, mood and pose within authored ranges.
Challenge mode shows a target expression and scores the logical parameter match, not computer vision.
No webcam, face recognition or MediaPipe dependency in the initial release.
content: One original rig, eight expression challenges, six saved pose slots in the project file.
